title: Taurus Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Taurus (April 20 – May 20) is the steady earth sign ruled by Venus. Calm, loyal and sensual, Taurus loves comfort, beauty and the simple pleasures that make life feel good.
personality: Taurus moves at its own pace and refuses to be rushed. Patient and reliable, they finish what they start and build things that last. They enjoy good food, music, nature and cozy spaces, and they have a strong sense of what is worth their time. Once they decide something, they are hard to move, which can be a strength or a stubborn streak.
strengths: Great taste and love of beauty
weaknesses: Sometimes too comfortable to try new things
love: Taurus loves slowly and deeply. They show affection through care, time, touch and small thoughtful gifts. Trust is everything: once they feel safe, they are among the most devoted partners in the zodiac.
career: Taurus excels in finance, design, cooking, architecture, gardening, music and any job that rewards steady effort and quality. They prefer stability and clear rewards over chaos.
friendship: Taurus friends are the rock of the group: always there, always honest, and always ready with good food and good advice.

faq.q: What is the Taurus personality like?
faq.ans: Taurus is patient, loyal, practical and loves comfort and beauty, but can be stubborn.

faq.q: Who is Taurus most compatible with?
faq.ans: Taurus often matches best with Virgo, Capricorn and Cancer, who share its need for stability.

faq.q: What is the lucky stone of Taurus?
faq.ans: Emerald is the traditional lucky stone for Taurus.
